name: traderx-fdc3-estate-desk-client
description: Estate desk-side FDC3 client (Spec 016). Runs INSIDE the estate desk page and connects the desk over WCP with the launching Desktop Agent. KEPT AS ITS OWN PACKAGE: its dependency tree (@finos/fdc3-get-agent + fdc3-agent-proxy) must never share node_modules with the Desktop Agent build — an install here once floated fdc3-schema to a beta and broke the agent bundle.
